description:
Here’s the real reason your dog is banned ❌

Housing barriers and landlord restrictions are consistently one of the top reasons guardians are forced to rehome their pets. 

The “Pets Belong With Families Act” could finally prohibit public housing agencies from banning dogs based on arbitrary breed or weight limits.

Banning breed restrictions is a direct pushback against a housing system that prioritizes corporate liability over keeping families together.
